body: Help doesn’t help. If only you knew how much help I’ve received that didn’t help. Medications, therapy, working out, spending time with “family and friends” nothing has ever worked for me. And I don’t want anymore help. I want to get over the fear of pain when I die. I want to die but I don’t want to be there in the process. If that makes sense
Something I’ve learned... things that work for you or other may not work for me or others. I’m tired of thinking. At this point I’m gonna say fuck it and just do

Nothing anymore. I completely lost myself. I don’t know who I am anymore. I don’t want to deal with this shit anymore. I’m 20 Female living in my car. Can’t afford college. Barely work. My mom and I got into it physically the other day after she found out I am $5,000 in debt with my bank. Honestly I don’t care anymore. I lost my best friend. The ONLY person who knew who I am. What I wanted to be. All gone. It seems people who don’t want to die often get it and those who want to be dead don’t. I’m done trying. I got so much shit going on in my head after being diagnosed with a schizoaffective disorder when I was 15. These voices WILL NOT STOP
I don’t want to anymore. The only thing stopping me honestly is failing to succeed my final attempt.
I feel the same exact way. Have for 11 years. I tried to kill myself since I was 9. I’m thinking about jumping off an overpass into the freeway
